protocol.changed_numerical_budget: The 200-iteration budget belongs only to historical offline inverse reference generation. The current online trajectory tracker has no solver or iteration budget.
protocol.scope: Current native fast trajectory tracking with exact simulator state, locked deterministic assessment cases (not holdout), no hardware, observer or terminal standup claim.

design.branch_policy: compare ordered contact geom pairs and constraint states against nominal at both epsilon sizes; use smaller epsilon, report every mismatch
design.state: exact native simulation state, no observer
design.reset: internal MjData reset each command; physical qpos/qvel continuous
design.assessment: locked before design/evaluation; these deterministic values only

protocol.selected_derivative_admission: Every selected 1e-7 column must stay on its nominal contact/constraint branch; coarse nominal-branch consistency <0.1 or exact-column 1e-7/1e-8 nominal-branch consistency <0.1. Original coarse failure retained; no global differentiability or contact-change stability guarantee.

method: Nonlinear reference from contact inverse + time-varying trajectory-error feedback; exact state diagnostic, no observer

branchDiagnostics.selected_derivative_scope: Finite local consistency for chosen nominal branch, not global differentiability or stability under contact changes.
